item.title: CMRLS Holiday Closing 1/19
item.description: All CMRLS Libraries will be closed Monday, January 19 for the Federal and State holiday. Regular library hours will resume on Tuesday, January 20. All digital resources, including reference materials, eBooks, eAudioBooks, eMagazines, and downloadable music are available at www.cmrls.lib.ms.us while libraries are closed.
